```{r}
df <- read_delim("roc_full_data.csv",
                 delim = ";",
                 locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"),
                 na = c("", "NA"))

if ("age " %in% names(df)) df <- df %>% rename(age = `age `)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    accuracy = as.character(accuracy),
    accuracy = str_trim(accuracy),
    accuracy = str_replace_all(accuracy, ",", "."),
    accuracy = str_replace_all(accuracy, "\\.\\.", "."),
    accuracy = ifelse(accuracy == "NR", "0", accuracy),
    accuracy = ifelse(accuracy %in% c("н","с","ф","o","p",
                                      "n","m","s","c","NA",""),
                      NA_character_, accuracy),
    accuracy = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(accuracy)),
    accuracy = ifelse(!is.na(accuracy) & !accuracy %in% c(0, 0.5, 1),
                      NA_real_, accuracy)
  )

df <- df %>% mutate(age = as.numeric(age))

cat("Субтестов:", length(unique(df$subtest)), "\n")
print(sort(unique(df$subtest)))
cat("\nПропуски в sex:", sum(is.na(df$sex)), "из", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Пропуски в accuracy:", sum(is.na(df$accuracy)), "из", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Пропуски в age:", sum(is.na(df$age)), "из", nrow(df), "\n")

df %>% filter(accuracy == 0) %>% nrow()
```

```{r}
df %>%

  count(subtest, group) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
```

```{r}
df_dp <- read_delim("roc_full_disc_prod.csv", delim = ";",
                    locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"), na = c("", "NA"))
glimpse(df_dp)
names(df_dp)
```
```{r}
df_dp <- df_dp %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(accuracy, coherence, lexicon, grammar, fluency),
           ~{
             x <- as.character(.x)
             x <- str_trim(x)
             x <- str_replace_all(x, ",", ".")
             x <- str_replace_all(x, "\\.\\.", ".")
             x <- ifelse(x == "NR", "0", x)
             x <- ifelse(x == "NA",
                         NA_character_, x)
             suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
           }),
    age = as.numeric(age)
  )
```

```{r}
sex_lookup <- df %>%
  select(ID, sex) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sex)) %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

df_dp_clean <- df_dp %>%
  mutate(
    accuracy = accuracy,
    accuracy = ifelse(is.nan(accuracy), NA, accuracy)
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    ID,
    group,
    subtest  = "discourse production",
    item     = 1L,
    age      = as.numeric(age),
    accuracy
  ) %>%
  left_join(sex_lookup, by = "ID")

df_no_dp <- df %>% filter(subtest != "discourse production")
df <- bind_rows(df_no_dp, df_dp_clean)

cat("После склейки DP: строк =", nrow(df), "\n")
df %>%
  filter(subtest == "discourse production") %>%
  count(group) %>%
  print()
```


```{r}
df_sp <- read_delim("roc_full_synt_prod.csv",
                    delim = ";",
                    locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"),
                    na = c("", "NA"))

df_sp <- df_sp %>%
  mutate(across(c(priming, lexicon, other, syntax),
                ~{
                  x <- as.character(.x)

                  x <- str_replace_all(x, ",", ".")
```

```{r}
desc_table <- df_subj %>%
  filter(!is.na(score), group %in% c("DLD","TD")) %>%
  group_by(subtest, group) %>%
  summarise(
    n      = n(),
    mean   = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd     = sd(score,   na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr    = IQR(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(desc_table, n = Inf)

group_tests <- df_subj %>%
  filter(!is.na(score), group %in% c("DLD","TD")) %>%
  group_by(subtest) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    d <- .x
    if (length(unique(d$group)) < 2) return(tibble())
    if (sum(!is.na(d$score[d$group=="DLD"])) < 3 ||
        sum(!is.na(d$score[d$group=="TD"]))  < 3) return(tibble())

    tt <- tryCatch(t.test(score ~ group, data = d), error = function(e) NULL)
    mw <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(score ~ group, data = d), error = function(e) NULL)
    cd <- tryCatch(cohen.d(score ~ group, data = d), error = function(e) NULL)

    tibble(
      t        = if (!is.null(tt)) unname(tt$statistic) else NA_real_,
      df       = if (!is.null(tt)) unname(tt$parameter) else NA_real_,
      p_t      = if (!is.null(tt)) tt$p.value          else NA_real_,
      p_mw     = if (!is.null(mw)) mw$p.value          else NA_real_,
      cohens_d = if (!is.null(cd)) unname(cd$estimate) else NA_real_,
      d_mag    = if (!is.null(cd)) as.character(cd$magnitude) else NA_character_
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p_t_fdr  = p.adjust(p_t,  method = "BH"),
    p_mw_fdr = p.adjust(p_mw, method = "BH")
  )
print(group_tests, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
roc_results <- df_subj %>%
  filter(!is.na(score), !is.na(age), group %in% c("DLD","TD")) %>%
  group_by(subtest) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    d <- .x
    if (length(unique(d$group)) < 2) return(tibble())
    d$group01 <- ifelse(d$group == "DLD", 1, 0)
    m <- glm(group01 ~ score + age, data = d, family = binomial)
    d$pred <- predict(m, type = "response")
    r <- roc(d$group, d$pred,
             levels = c("TD","DLD"),
             direction = "<",
             quiet = TRUE)
    ci   <- ci.auc(r)
    best <- coords(r, "best",
                   ret = c("threshold","sensitivity","specificity",
                           "ppv","npv","youden"),
                   best.method = "youden")
    tibble(
      AUC         = as.numeric(auc(r)),
      CI_low      = as.numeric(ci[1]),
      CI_high     = as.numeric(ci[3]),
      threshold   = best$threshold,
      sensitivity = best$sensitivity,
      specificity = best$specificity,
      PPV         = best$ppv,
      NPV         = best$npv,
      youden      = best$youden,
      n_DLD       = sum(d$group == "DLD"),
      n_TD        = sum(d$group == "TD")
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(AUC))

print(roc_results, n = Inf)
```
```{r}
prev <- 0.07

roc_results <- roc_results %>%
  mutate(
    PPV_adj = (sensitivity * prev) /
              (sensitivity * prev + (1 - specificity) * (1 - prev)),
    NPV_adj = (specificity * (1 - prev)) /
              (specificity * (1 - prev) + (1 - sensitivity) * prev)
  )
print(roc_results %>% select(subtest, AUC, sensitivity, specificity,
                             PPV_adj, NPV_adj), n = Inf)
```



```{r}
roc_pretty <- roc_results %>%
  transmute(
    Subtest  = subtest,
    AUC      = sprintf("%.2f", AUC),
    `95% CI` = sprintf("%.2f–%.2f", CI_low, CI_high),
    Sens     = sprintf("%.2f", sensitivity),
    Spec     = sprintf("%.2f", specificity),
    PPV_adj  = sprintf("%.2f", PPV_adj),
    NPV_adj  = sprintf("%.2f", NPV_adj),
    `n DLD`  = n_DLD,
    `n TD`   = n_TD
  )

roc_pretty %>%
  kable(
    caption  = "ROC by Subtest (age-adjusted, prevalence = 0.07)",
    align    = c("l","c","c","c","c","c","c","c","c"),
    booktabs = TRUE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("striped","hold_position"),
    full_width    = FALSE
  ) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```


```{r}
plot_list <- list()
for (st in unique(df_subj$subtest)) {
  d <- df_subj %>% filter(subtest == st, !is.na(score), !is.na(age),
                          group %in% c("DLD","TD"))
  if (length(unique(d$group)) < 2) next
  d$group01 <- ifelse(d$group == "DLD", 1, 0)
  m <- glm(group01 ~ score + age, data = d, family = binomial)
  d$pred <- predict(m, type = "response")
  r <- roc(d$group, d$pred, levels = c("TD","DLD"),
           direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)
  plot_list[[st]] <- ggroc(r) +
    ggtitle(paste0(st, " (AUC = ", round(auc(r), 2), ")")) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
    theme_minimal()
}

ggarrange(plotlist = plot_list[1:4], ncol = 2, nrow = 2)
ggarrange(plotlist = plot_list[5:8], ncol = 2, nrow = 2)
ggarrange(plotlist = plot_list[9:length(plot_list)], ncol = 2, nrow = 2)
```


```{r}
roc_all <- df_subj %>%
  filter(!is.na(score), !is.na(age), group %in% c("DLD","TD")) %>%
  group_by(subtest) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    d <- .x
    if (length(unique(d$group)) < 2) return(tibble())
    d$group01 <- ifelse(d$group == "DLD", 1, 0)
    m <- glm(group01 ~ score + age, data = d, family = binomial)
    d$pred <- predict(m, type = "response")
    r <- roc(d$group, d$pred, levels = c("TD","DLD"),
             direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)
    tibble(spec = rev(r$specificities),
           sens = rev(r$sensitivities))
  }) %>% ungroup()

ggplot(roc_all, aes(x = 1 - spec, y = sens, color = subtest)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "1 - Specificity", y = "Sensitivity",
       title = "ROC by Subtest (age-adjusted)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
alpha_item <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(accuracy),
         subtest %in% c("noun comprehension","noun production",
                        "verb comprehension","verb production",
                        "pseudoword comprehension","pseudoword repetition",
                        "sentence comprehension","sentence repetition",
                        "discourse comprehension")) %>%
  group_by(subtest, group) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    wide <- .x %>%
      select(ID, item, accuracy) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = item, values_from = accuracy)
    mat <- wide %>% select(-ID) %>% as.data.frame()

    keep <- sapply(mat, function(x) {
      !all(is.na(x)) && sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
    })
    mat <- mat[, keep, drop = FALSE]

    mat <- mat[complete.cases(mat), , drop = FALSE]

    if (ncol(mat) < 2 || nrow(mat) < 10) {
      return(tibble(alpha = NA_real_, n_items = ncol(mat), n_subj = nrow(mat)))
    }

    a <- psych::alpha(mat, warnings = FALSE)
    tibble(alpha = a$total$raw_alpha,
           n_items = ncol(mat),
           n_subj  = nrow(mat))
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    alpha   = round(alpha, 3),
    n_items = as.integer(n_items),
    n_subj  = as.integer(n_subj)
  )

print(alpha_item, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
alpha_dp <- df_dp %>%
  filter(!is.na(coherence), !is.na(grammar),
         !is.na(lexicon), !is.na(fluency)) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    alpha   = psych::alpha(
                as.data.frame(cbind(coherence, grammar, lexicon, fluency)),
                warnings = FALSE)$total$raw_alpha,
    n_items = 4L,
    n_subj  = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(subtest = "discourse production",
         alpha = round(alpha, 3)) %>%
  select(subtest, group, alpha, n_items, n_subj)

print(alpha_dp)
```

```{r}
df_sp_subj <- df_sp %>%

                as.data.frame(cbind(priming, lexicon, other, syntax)),

    n_items = 4L,
    n_subj  = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(subtest = "sentence production",
         alpha = round(alpha, 3)) %>%
  select(subtest, group, alpha, n_items, n_subj)

print(alpha_sp)
```

```{r}
desc_table_pretty <- desc_table %>%
  mutate(
    M_SD  = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean, sd),
    Mdn_IQR = sprintf("%.3f [%.3f–%.3f]", median, iqr - median/2, iqr + median/2)
  ) %>%
  select(subtest, group, n, M_SD) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group,
              values_from = c(n, M_SD),
              names_glue = "{.value}_{group}")

desc_table_pretty <- desc_table_pretty %>%
  select(subtest, n_DLD, n_TD, M_SD_DLD, M_SD_TD) %>%
  rename(
    Subtest  = subtest,
    `n (DLD)` = n_DLD,
    `n (TD)`  = n_TD,
    `DLD M (SD)` = M_SD_DLD,
    `TD M (SD)`  = M_SD_TD
  )

desc_table_pretty %>%
  kable(
    caption = "Descriptive statistics based on subtest and group",
    align   = c("l","c","c","c","c"),
    booktabs = TRUE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("striped","hold_position"),
    full_width    = FALSE
  ) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```


```{r}
group_tests_pretty <- group_tests %>%
  mutate(
    t_stat   = sprintf("%.2f", t),
    df_stat  = sprintf("%.1f", df),
    p_t_str  = ifelse(p_t_fdr < .001, "< .001", sprintf("%.3f", p_t_fdr)),
    p_mw_str = ifelse(p_mw_fdr < .001, "< .001", sprintf("%.3f", p_mw_fdr)),
    d_str    = sprintf("%.2f", cohens_d),
    d_mag    = case_when(
      d_mag == "negligible" ~ "negligible",
      d_mag == "small"      ~ "small",
      d_mag == "medium"     ~ "medium",
      d_mag == "large"      ~ "large",
      TRUE                  ~ d_mag
    )
  ) %>%
  select(subtest, t_stat, df_stat, p_t_str, p_mw_str, d_str, d_mag) %>%
  rename(
    Subtest        = subtest,
    `t`            = t_stat,
    `df`           = df_stat,
    `p (t-test, FDR)`   = p_t_str,
    `p (MW, FDR)`       = p_mw_str,
    `Cohen's d`    = d_str,
    `Effect size`  = d_mag
  )

group_tests_pretty %>%
  kable(
    caption = "Comparison of DLD and TD Groups by Subtest",
    align   = c("l","c","c","c","c","c","l"),
    booktabs = TRUE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("striped","hold_position"),
    full_width    = FALSE
  ) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(4:5, background = "transparent")
```
